paragraphs: Prasad Perera | NSW Registered Architect | Interior Designer | Licensed Builder | Director

Prasad Perera is a Registered Architect with the NSW Architects Registration Board and the Director of dp Design Studio Pty Ltd and Daylo Build Pty Ltd. He brings architecture, interior design, planning approvals and construction together through one integrated service.

With extensive experience across residential and commercial projects throughout Sydney, Prasad combines creative design thinking with practical construction knowledge. He is known for his responsive, hands-on approach and commitment to efficient coordination and quick project turnaround.

As both a Registered Architect and Licensed Builder, Prasad understands how to balance design quality, functionality, buildability, budget and long-term value. From the initial concept through approvals, consultant coordination, interior design and construction, he provides clients with clear communication, professional guidance and confidence at every stage.
In Prasad's own words
"My design philosophy is centred on creating meaningful, sustainable spaces that enhance health, wellbeing and the way people connect with one another and their surroundings.

I believe good architecture should balance beauty with functionality, comfort, buildability and long-term value. Every project should respond thoughtfully to its occupants, location, natural light, ventilation, landscape and environmental conditions rather than following a standard formula.

Where appropriate, I incorporate biophilic design, Vastu, Feng Shui and selected ancient spatial philosophies into contemporary architecture to encourage balance, tranquillity and a stronger connection with nature.

As both a Registered Architect and Licensed Builder, I approach every design with creativity and practical construction knowledge. My goal is to create distinctive spaces that are environmentally responsible, commercially realistic and genuinely improve the lives of those who experience them."
To transform ideas into meaningful spaces that positively influence how people live, work and feel.

My passion is to create sustainable, thoughtfully designed environments that strengthen the connection between people, nature and the spaces they experience every day. I am also interested in thoughtfully integrating Vastu, Feng Shui, biophilic design and selected ancient spatial philosophies with contemporary architecture.

Working as both a Registered Architect and Licensed Builder allows me to carry a client’s vision from the first concept through approvals and construction. It is incredibly rewarding to see an idea become a completed space that improves wellbeing, supports everyday life and delivers lasting value.

I most enjoy projects where architecture can genuinely improve the way people live, work and connect with their surroundings. This includes bespoke new homes, major renovations, extensions, interior transformations and thoughtfully designed commercial spaces.

I particularly enjoy challenging projects where the site, planning controls or client requirements call for a creative and practical solution. Whether transforming an outdated property, designing a sustainable family home or delivering a complete commercial project, I enjoy guiding the client from the initial idea through approvals and construction.
The most rewarding projects are those where we create something distinctive, functional and meaningful while making the entire process as clear, efficient and stress-free as possible for the client.

Realising Your Bathroom Design Ideas How Your Bathroom Design or Renovation Works Bathroom Design Services Realising Your Bathroom Design Ideas How Your Bathroom Design or Renovation Works Bathroom Design Services The Bathroom Design Process Bathroom designs are simply defined by their look — clean, straight lines, geometric shapes, and uncluttered counter spaces dominate the landscape. dp Design Studio will discuss your modern bathroom ideas and needs.
We then plan the layout, factoring in storage, lighting, tiling, and ventilation. We help you create a relaxing haven that fits in with your requirements.

It all begins with an idea. Our consultant will meet with you and assess what can be done with the space you have available. We will then draw up bespoke plans and identify the fixtures and accessories for installation in your new bathroom.

Once everything is agreed, we’ll pull together a team of expert tradesmen to execute the build. No matter what you want — modern, contemporary, or traditional — we will create a light, airy space that you’ll want to spend more time in.

If you’re wondering how we design a good bathroom, here are some of the factors we take into account: 9 Assessing your needs We work with you to find out what type of bath you want — a freestanding tub or one with a shower built in? Maybe a spa-style bath appeals to you, or no bathtub at all — just a large, spacious shower area. 9 Ventilation Irrespective of where in the home your bathroom is situated, ventilation is an important aspect to take into consideration. A bathroom that suffers from residual condensation can lead to mould and mildew formation. 9 Planning the layout You don’t want to be squeezing past the bath to get to the washbasin or, if it’s not separate, the toilet. We will maximise the space to give you a bathroom that functions, while still reflecting your style. 9 Storage Creating an uncluttered, harmonious space means storage is a must. We can be innovative in factoring in cupboards, drawers, and cabinets, to accommodate your bathroom necessities. 9 Lighting There will be times when you require as much light as possible, and others when you want it to be muted and soft. We can address these needs and incorporate a lighting solution that gives you the best of both worlds. 9 Tiling and painting One of the easiest ways to stay on trend is the clever use of paint and tiles. We can advise you on what works best with your bathroom design ideas. 9 Being realistic about space Sometimes there might be no option but to work with the space you have available. In this situation, we’ll discuss various options with you. We will look at whether doors or windows can be relocated to make the best use of the bathroom. Alternatively, maybe a wall can be moved to create a larger area. How Your Bathroom Design or Renovation Works If your bathroom design is a renovation or a redesign of an existing space, we’ll ensure that the floors in your home, between the bathroom and exit point, are protected. We will then carefully strip out existing fittings and relocate any doors or walls, as agreed on the design.

Following this, we will rough-in the wiring and plumbing, ready for the lighting, power points, and fixtures. Your walls will be prepared for waterproofing and tiling, in accordance with regulations. We always make sure we adhere to set standards and obtain all the necessary approvals and inspections.
The tiling work will be carried out, using only high-quality adhesives and sealants — then it’s time for the fixtures to be installed. All plumbing will be connected and painting completed.

Finally, mirrors and shower screens will be put in place, and any accessories, such as feature lighting and shelving, added. We will clean up and give the install a final inspection before handing over your beautiful new bathroom.
